scientific_integrity: Analytical proof based on characteristic polynomials and the normalized Joukowski map, with Schwarz-lemma equality establishing uniqueness. All numerical tests are supplementary finite diagnostics; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Constant-but-unknown scalar drift in an entire real interval; fixed real finite-tap full-state-feedback and known unit input gain.
The criterion concerns spectral radius and simultaneous Schur stability, not LQR cost or nonlinear or switched dynamics.
At extreme drift values repeated eigenvalues may prevent a pure geometric bound with the exact spectral factor.
Some relevant classical robust-Schur and simultaneous-stabilization full texts were unavailable, leaving bibliographic overlap uncertainty.
title: Sharp interval-robust rates and rigidity of scalar finite-memory feedback
